title: Generated storm lifecycles fill the rare-event tail of short rainfall records
abstract: arXiv:2610.41365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Historically rare ''one-in-a-generation'' storms are occurring with unprecedented frequency, causing catastrophic damage and mounting casualties, and exposing the vulnerability of infrastructure designed around short observational records. To overcome the limitations of sparse data, we present StormGen, a generative machine-learning model that transforms an observed storm's initial hours into complete, physically plausible hourly rainfall lifecycles in minutes. Evaluated on a decade of southeast Texas rainfall, StormGen produced close counterparts for 4\5% of the most severe 2\% of storms--compared to just 3\% for stochastic storm transposition--and maintained spatial coherence over full 24-hour sequences. Crucially, from a single hour of initial rainfall, the model successfully reconstructed the specific lifecycle, spatial pattern, and extreme catchment totals of Hurricane Harvey itself, despite the event being entirely absent in traini

translated_title: 生成的风暴生命周期填补短降雨记录中的罕见事件尾部
translated_abstract: 历史上罕见的“一代人一遇”风暴正以前所未有的频率发生，造成灾难性破坏和不断攀升的伤亡人数，并暴露出基于短期观测记录设计的基础设施的脆弱性。为克服数据稀疏的局限，我们提出了StormGen——一个生成式机器学习模型，它能在几分钟内将观测风暴最初几小时的降雨数据转化为完整且物理上合理的逐小时降雨生命周期。在德克萨斯州东南部十年降雨数据的评估中，StormGen为最严重的2%风暴中的45%生成了高度接近的对应事件——相比之下，随机风暴置换方法仅为3%——并且在完整的24小时序列中保持了空间一致性。至关重要的是，仅凭最初一小时的降雨数据，该模型成功重建了哈维飓风本身特有的生命周期、空间模式和极端流域降雨总量，尽管该事件在训练数据中完全缺失。
tldr: 研究提出StormGen生成式机器学习模型，能从风暴最初几小时的降雨数据快速生成完整且物理合理的风暴生命周期，有效填补短降雨记录中极端罕见风暴的尾部数据，甚至仅凭一小时数据就成功重建了训练中完全未出现的哈维飓风。
en_tdlr: StormGen, a generative machine-learning model, transforms a storm's initial hours of rainfall into complete, physically plausible lifecycles, filling the rare-event tail of short rainfall records and successfully reconstructing Hurricane Harvey from a single hour of data despite its absence from training.
